digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate calibration and measurement (E3 counterfactual replay)
propositions: Deterministic reproducible stratified sample of ~200 cleanly-closed historical plan reviews must be built and frozen to enable counterfactual gate replay without LLM cost.

Pure LLM-free metrics library with golden tests must compute verdict perturbations (criterion_deltas, pass_to_block_flip_rate, fp_control_eval) to measure false-positive and advisory count changes under gate candidates.
Replay driver must strip prior REVIEW_RESULT.json files and implement material-fingerprint drift guards to isolate candidate effect and control for recall contamination.

Live ~450-run LLM batch replay for coarse sweep + precise candidate/current fresh runs is permanently rejected on cost and superseded by standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder (d8a5) that accumulates the same signal at zero marginal cost from production reviews.

Deterministic infrastructure (sample, baseline, metrics, driver seams, tests) is intentionally delivered as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 and not landed on main because the only runtime purpose of the driver (the live batch replay) was rejected.
